description: Cycle Lane is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ordnance Survey. Also named: CycleLane A linear feature that describes a cycle lane or cycle track and it's relationship to the road or path network. The Cycle Lane Feature Type represents designated cycling infrastructure, not cycle routes. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Ordnance Survey. The portal shows 2025-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
